# WA Validator — WhatsApp Number Checker API

> Check if a phone number is registered on WhatsApp. One number per request, synchronous JSON response. 1 credit per number.

## Endpoint
POST https://wavalidator.com/api/v1/validate/
Headers: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY ; Content-Type: application/json
Body: {"phone_number": "14155551234"}

## Response
{"phone_number": "14155551234", "status": "valid", "credits_remaining": 99}
status: "valid" = has WhatsApp; "invalid" = no WhatsApp or malformed number; "error" = check failed, retry, not charged.
Optional field: "cached": true when served from a recent check.

## Number format
Country code + national number, digits only. "+", spaces and "-" are stripped. Must be 7-15 digits. Drop the national trunk 0 (UK 07911123456 -> 447911123456).

## Errors
400 bad JSON / missing phone_number; 401 bad or missing key; 402 no credits; 429 rate limit ({"status":"limit","retry_after":N}); 5xx retry with backoff.
Default limit 20 requests/minute per key plus a daily quota per plan. Headers: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset.
